title: Entra passkey profiles and Windows passkeys GA slipped to July 2027
summary: Message Center updates move general availability of Entra ID passkey profiles (and migration for existing FIDO2 passkey tenants) and of Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows from the previous late-2026 targets to 2 July 2027 (MC1221452 and MC1282568 timeline updates). Preview and interim guidance remain available; the calendar commitment for GA is what changed.
why: Programmes that assumed passkey-profile GA before end of 2026 need a replan. Phishing-resistant MFA for admins should not wait on that GA — use existing authentication strengths and passkey (FIDO2) methods that are already supported, and treat profiles as the later management plane improvement.
todo: Update roadmap and CAB dates that assumed 2026 GA for passkey profiles / Windows passkeys.
Keep rolling out passkeys with today's authentication method policies and Conditional Access authentication strengths.
Watch MC1221452 and MC1282568 for further timeline changes rather than third-party roundups.
effective_note: Updated GA target 2 July 2027 per Message Center timeline changes (MC1221452, MC1282568).
